validation_queries.description: Verify that MPI function name strings are present in the table
validation_queries.error_message: No 'MPI_' strings found in the table rocpd_string
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE string LIKE 'MPI\_%' ESCAPE '\';

validation_queries.description: Verify entries have non-zero start times
validation_queries.error_message: Found entries with zero start times in regions table

validation_queries.description: Verify that 'mpi' appears in category at least once in table regions
validation_queries.error_message: 'mpi' category entries are fewer than expected in regions

validation_queries.description: Verify every process records its MPI rank as an integer
validation_queries.error_message: Found processes without an integer MPI_COMM_WORLD_RANK in their environment
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE json_type(environment, '$.MPI_COMM_WORLD_RANK') IS NOT 'integer';
